isd.text: Geralf Cecani and his twin sister Gisa are banished from Thraben in a hushed scandal and move to the Moorland, where they wage war on each other with undead armies.
Geralf takes over the village of Trostad and Gisa attacks it just to best her brother, starting NecroWarfare, and Geralf tries to set formal rules for the war, which Gisa ignores.

Geralf then starts the siege of Thraben and invites Gisa along, hurling hordes of ghouls and skaabs at its walls while he sneaks into the city and stabs his cousin Mikaeus to death, and Liliana brings Mikaeus back as a zombie.
Geralf later sends skaabs to free Gisa, who says she did not need his help, and he busies himself with his masterpiece.

dka.text: With Avacyn absent, Geralf and Gisa besiege Thraben, and Geralf sneaks behind the defenses and stabs Mikaeus with a letter opener, carving out his heart.
Gisa calls to him by throwing bones at her brother.
